checks.name: factory_scene_and_catalog
checks.criterion: Five fixed classes, at least six identities per class, 20 semantic display objects, and a static factory scene.

checks.name: public_operator_workflow
checks.criterion: Clean reopen, Play, public demo_start.py, one capture, public demo_stop, zero remaining callbacks, and stopped timeline.

checks.name: authored_pose_startup_stability
checks.criterion: No visible arm snap; authored Panda and IKTarget agree within 1 mm translation and 0.002 rad orientation at startup.

checks.name: d455_capture_geometry
checks.criterion: Stereo baseline 0.095 m +/- 0.002 m, valid raw depth, restored target visibility, and unchanged USD hash.

checks.name: visual_full_rack_framing
checks.observed: Left, right, and color RGB directly reviewed; all show the complete three-tier rack and representative contents without D455 self-occlusion.
checks.criterion: The primary left D455 view is useful for the intended full-rack perception scene.

checks.name: camera_follows_iktarget
checks.criterion: A distinct reachable runtime IKTarget pose moves both panda_hand and the rigidly attached left camera without controller errors.

checks.name: source_and_candidate_immutability
checks.criterion: Runtime validation never overwrites the protected baseline, reviewed source candidate, or accepted revision.

known_limitations: Factory objects are project-authored proxy assets with redistribution_allowed=false until repository-level license terms are supplied.
The clean Panda pose places joint4 close to its lower limit; the public startup reconciliation remains below the documented 1 mm and 0.002 rad acceptance tolerances.
Isaac Kit reports the root layer dirty after clean reopen/render initialization; no stage save occurred and all disk hashes remained unchanged.
The Isaac MCP execute_script response wrapper may return a schema error or stall after payload completion; fresh scratch envelopes and file timestamps are the operation authority.
